summary: Official English and Indonesian discovery found Tarakan's municipal Peta Bidang Tanah catalog record, its named local land-data producer, and the official Gunung Lingkas administrative listing. The catalog record has no exposed geometry/download and the public ATR/BPN viewer yielded no safe anonymous parcel response, so no sample was retained.
queryOutcomes: Both first-party discovery queries are recorded in the city record with actual result URLs. English search found Tarakan municipal land-map and ATR/BPN leads; Indonesian search confirmed the local kelurahan and the municipal Peta Bidang Tanah record.
requestOutcomes: Tarakan catalog metadata, catalog API documentation, catalog search, district listing, BHUMI shell, current embedded console, and historical BPS publication were fetched over verified HTTPS. The catalog search returned metadata only; no parcel ID, geometry, CRS, or downloadable file was exposed. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, unsafe field, or TLS-disable exception was used.
scopeLimits: Local registry/custodian evidence is metadata and administrative provenance, not verified open parcel geometry
No citywide or exact-point parcel inference made
National ATR/BPN viewer distinguished from the local Tarakan custodian
No credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS-disable exception used
uncertainty: The municipal map may be a document, restricted layer, or interactive workflow not exposed by the inspected catalog. A missing download and an unusable/empty public viewer route do not prove citywide absence.

runtimeQualification.reason: No independently qualified real Gunung Lingkas adapter or verified public parcel geometry/native-ID response.
